[SWS_SM_00657] Transition to StateMachine State ContinueUpdate
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
is started [SWS_SM_00648] during
an active update session it shall enter
ContinueUpdate
State instead of
Initial
State
.
⌋
Please note that a reset can happen either on request of
Update and Configura-
tion Management
(see [SWS_SM_00202]) or in an unintended way (e.g. Watchdog
reset, power loss, ...).
A different behavior is needed, because
State Management
is not aware how far
Update and Configuration Management
proceeded with the update. Therefore
only processes should be started which are essential to continue the update.
